data.name: Tihyansh
data.gender_notes: Tihyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tihyansh is a name derived from Sanskrit and Hindu traditions. It is believed to be a name of the God of strength and prosperity. The name is composed of the words 'Tih' which means sun and 'Yansh' which means God. Thus, Tihyansh is the name of the deity who is believed to bring strength and prosperity to those who bear this name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tihyansh is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed to be a name of the Sun God and is often used to invoke the blessings of this deity. The name is said to bring strength, courage, and prosperity to those who bear it.
data.etymology: Tihyansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of strength and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tihyansh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
